title: High-Throughput E-Commerce Order Streaming

asrs.statement: The platform shall ingest and process up to 50,000 checkout events per second during peak flash sales.
Payment processing failures must be isolated and not halt inventory or order capture streams.

notes: High concurrency asynchronous stream with strict fault isolation.

title: Banking Ledger and Audit Management

asrs.statement: All transactions must be strictly audited with cryptographic tamper protection and role-based access control.
Financial statements must enforce deterministic consistency and rollback capabilities on failure.

notes: Strict transactional boundaries, centralized authorization, and verifiable ledger layers.

title: Internal Company HR & Employee Management Portal

asrs.statement: The portal shall be easily maintainable by a small 3-person developer team with minimal operational complexity.
New employee profile modules and payroll reporting plugins must be modularly extendable without full re-architecture.

notes: Small team boundary favors unified deployment units with clear internal domain modularity.

title: Industrial IoT Fleet Telemetry Ingestion

asrs.statement: The telemetry gateway shall ingest sensor time-series packets from 250,000 edge devices with under 100ms processing latency.
Critical temperature warning events must be immediately broadcasted to alerting services asynchronously.

notes: Asynchronous event pub-sub pipeline with low latency alert dispatch.

title: Hospital Patient Records and Monitoring Hub

asrs.statement: Medical records access must comply with HIPAA, maintaining complete data confidentiality and tamper-proof audit trails.
The vital sign alerting subsystem must guarantee 99.999% uptime and zero single points of failure.

notes: Regulatory compliance with mission-critical high availability and fault isolation.
